title_es: Anthropic completa su salida a bolsa con $93.6 mil millones de valoración
bajada: Anthropic cerró exitosamente su IPO con 1,127 millones de acciones a $83 por acción, incluyendo el ejercicio completo de la opción de los colocadores. Este hito marca la consolidación de la empresa como uno de los principales actores en la industria de IA.

title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
title_es: Nvidia pausa envíos de chips a Sudeste Asiático por restricciones a China
bajada: Nvidia ha ordenado a sus socios manufactureros detener envíos de servidores a Malasia, Singapur, Tailandia e Indonesia como parte de nuevas restricciones estadounidenses para evitar que chips de IA lleguen a China. La medida refleja la intensificación del control de exportaciones tecnológicas.
bajada_en: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia as part of new U.S. restrictions to prevent AI chips from reaching China. The measure reflects intensifying tech export controls.

title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts - […]
title_es: 42 fiscales estatales frenan venta de datos de usuarios de Character.AI
bajada: Una coalición de 42 fiscales generales de EE.UU. busca impedir que Character.AI venda datos personales de más de 21 millones de usuarios durante su proceso de quiebra. La acción representa un precedente importante en protección de privacidad de usuarios de plataformas de IA.
bajada_en: A coalition of 42 U.S. state attorneys general is seeking to block Character.AI from selling personal data of over 21 million users during bankruptcy proceedings. The action sets an important precedent for user privacy protection on AI platforms.

title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency […]
title_es: FCC autoriza SpaceX a lanzar hasta 1 millón de satélites de datos para IA
bajada: La FCC aprobó el plan de SpaceX "Starmind" para desplegar hasta 1 millón de satélites equipados con chips de IA en órbita. Google y Blue Origin también persiguen iniciativas similares, abriendo una nueva frontera en infraestructura distribuida.
bajada_en: FCC approved SpaceX's "Starmind" plan to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites in orbit. Google and Blue Origin are also pursuing similar initiatives, opening a new frontier in distributed infrastructure.

title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
summary: The FCA warned against “another force of attack” from agents after the company declined a request to work on joint testing ahead of rolling out its personal agent in the UK on Tuesday.
title_es: Meta rechaza compartir Muse con reguladores británicos antes del lanzamiento
bajada: La FCA británica criticó que Meta se negara a realizar pruebas conjuntas de su agente personal Muse antes de su lanzamiento en UK. La disputa subraya tensiones crecientes entre reguladores y empresas de IA sobre pruebas de seguridad.
bajada_en: UK's FCA criticized Meta for refusing joint testing of its personal agent Muse before UK launch. The dispute highlights growing tensions between regulators and AI companies over safety testing.

title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
summary:
arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_\theta(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_\theta$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $\theta$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.
title_es: Context Scaling: una nueva frontera en el escalamiento de IA
bajada: Un nuevo paper en arXiv introduce Context Scaling como complemento a las estrategias tradicionales de escalamiento de IA. El enfoque aborda cómo los sistemas pueden acceder y mantener el contexto adecuado en tiempo de decisión.
bajada_en: A new arXiv paper introduces Context Scaling as a complement to traditional AI scaling strategies. The approach addresses how systems can access and maintain proper context at decision time.

title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
summary:
arXiv:2611.33174v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents need persistent memory that surfaces the right past interaction at the right time across thousands of turns. Many systems index by invoking generative LLMs to rewrite history into summaries, facts, or knowledge graphs--a step that is (a) costly (thousands of generative calls per build), (b) non-deterministic (undermining reproducibility and giving inconsistent answers across runs), and (c) provenance-erasing (the reader sees synthesized text, not the original turn). We propose MGMem, a framework with no generative indexing calls that replaces this step with a deterministic discriminative-parser pipeline: recurring mentions across sessions are organized into an incidence graph, question mentions are resolved by a subject-conditioned three-stage resolver, and raw dialogue episodes are returned to the reader. On English multi-session dialogue QA, MGMem outperforms matched-protocol baselines on LoCoMo without generative indexing calls; on the full LongMemEval-S, it remains competitive overall and leads or ties on single-session types among local retrieval comparisons. Code: https://github.com/junhong-h/MGMem
title_es: MGMem: memoria determinística para agentes LLM de largo horizonte
bajada: Investigadores proponen MGMem, un framework que mejora la memoria persistente de agentes LLM sin requerir costosas llamadas generativas. El enfoque es determinístico, reproducible y preserva la proveniencia de datos.
bajada_en: Researchers propose MGMem, a framework that improves persistent memory for LLM agents without expensive generative calls. The approach is deterministic, reproducible, and preserves data provenance.

title: Trump to Lead TSMC Arizona Groundbreaking Ceremony After Bringing Huang Back to Nvidia
summary: President Donald Trump will lead a groundbreaking ceremony on December 4 for the expansion of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company‘s chip plant in Phoenix, Bloomberg reported, citing a White House official. TSMC executives, suppliers and customers are expected to attend. It isn’t clear ...
title_es: Trump presidirá ceremonia de expansión de TSMC en Arizona
bajada: El presidente Trump liderará la ceremonia de puesta de piedra para la expansión de la planta de TSMC en Phoenix el 4 de diciembre. El evento marca un hito en la estrategia de EE.UU. de fortalecer su capacidad doméstica de manufactura de chips.
bajada_en: President Trump will lead groundbreaking ceremony for TSMC's Phoenix plant expansion on December 4. The event marks a milestone in the U.S. strategy to strengthen domestic chip manufacturing capacity.

title: firecrawl /firecrawl
summary: 🔥 Firecrawl Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three. Firecrawl Local . Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost. Firecrawl Cloud . Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone. Self-hosting . Deploy the full Firecrawl server from apps/api with its own queues, workers and databases on your own infrastructure. Pst. Hey, you, join our stargazers :) Firecrawl Local Firecrawl Local scrapes, crawls and maps from your own machine without a database, queue or container, and it reaches Firecrawl Cloud when your AI agents need search or Alexandria. It installs from crates.io. You need Rust and a C compiler, which on macOS means xcode-select --install and on Debian or Ubuntu means build-essential . cargo install firecrawl-local If you don't have Rust, Firecrawl Cloud runs the same scrape with nothing to build and no signup. npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest scrape https://firecrawl.dev Scrape a page and print its markdown. firecrawl-local scrape https://firecrawl.dev --markdown Crawl a site and save one markdown file per page. firecrawl-local crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev --limit 50 --out ./pages List every URL on a site. firecrawl-local map https://firecrawl.dev Pages that need JavaScript render in the Chrome or Chromium already on your machine, and PDFs and Office documents are parsed locally too. Without a browser, static pages still work and a page that needed one comes back with a warning. Add it to your AI agent init finds Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI and Codex on your machine and adds Firecrawl Loca
title_es: Firecrawl: infraestructura de conocimiento para agentes de IA
bajada: Firecrawl lanza versión local como herramienta open-source para convertir sitios web en markdown limpio y conectarlo a agentes de IA. Disponible como binary local o servicio cloud con acceso a +550 proveedores de datos.
bajada_en: Firecrawl launches local version as open-source tool to convert websites into clean markdown for AI agents. Available as local binary or cloud service with access to 550+ data providers.

title: Building on Nemotron 3.5 Parse: Open Data, Fine-Tuning, and Faster Inference
title_es: Avances en Nemotron 3.5 Parse: datos abiertos e inferencia más rápida
bajada: Nvidia y Hugging Face comparten mejoras en Nemotron 3.5 Parse con nuevos datos abiertos y optimizaciones de inference. Estos desarrollos permiten que los developers trabajen con modelos más eficientes para parsing de texto.
bajada_en: Nvidia and Hugging Face share improvements to Nemotron 3.5 Parse with new open data and inference optimizations. These developments enable developers to work with more efficient text parsing models.

title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
title_es: Guía para construir y entrenar sistemas multi-agentes con IA
bajada: Hugging Face publica recursos sobre cómo construir, entrenar y evaluar sistemas multi-agentes (swarms, flocks, gangs). Esta guía es especialmente útil para developers que experimentan con orquestación de agentes de IA.
bajada_en: Hugging Face publishes resources on building, training, and evaluating multi-agent systems (swarms, flocks, gangs). This guide is particularly useful for developers experimenting with AI agent orchestration.

title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
title_es: OpenAI introduce medidor único de uso al fusionar Chat y Work
bajada: OpenAI combinará sus productos Chat y Work bajo un único medidor de uso, lo que significa que usuarios activos podrían alcanzar límites de tasa más rápidamente. Este cambio unifica la experiencia pero ajusta la política de límites de acceso.
bajada_en: OpenAI will combine Chat and Work products under a single usage meter, meaning heavy users may hit rate limits sooner. This change unifies the experience but adjusts access limit policies.

title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
title_es: Dashboard de benchmarks de llama.cpp para AMD Ryzen y Radeon
bajada: Se lanza un nuevo dashboard de benchmarks que mide el rendimiento de llama.cpp en procesadores AMD Ryzen y GPUs Radeon. Herramienta útil para developers que buscan optimizar modelos en hardware AMD.
bajada_en: A new benchmarks dashboard launches measuring llama.cpp performance on AMD Ryzen processors and Radeon GPUs. Useful tool for developers optimizing models on AMD hardware.

title: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
title_es: Científicos marcan límites en agentes de IA: análisis de Allen Institute
bajada: Allen Institute publica análisis sobre dónde establecer límites en las capacidades de agentes de IA. El trabajo explora implicaciones éticas y técnicas del desarrollo de sistemas autónomos.
bajada_en: Allen Institute publishes analysis on where to draw lines on AI agent capabilities. The work explores ethical and technical implications of autonomous system development.

title: openvinotoolkit /openvino
summary: Open-source software toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models. Documentation • Blog • Key Features • Tutorials • Integrations • Benchmarks • Generative AI Inference Optimization : Boost deep learning performance in computer vision, automatic speech recognition, generative AI, natural language processing with large and small language models, and many other common tasks. Flexible Model Support : Use models trained with popular frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, and JAX/Flax. Directly integrate models built with transformers and diffusers from the Hugging Face Hub using Optimum Intel. Convert and deploy models without original frameworks. Broad Platform Compatibility : Reduce resource demands and efficiently deploy on a range of platforms from edge to cloud. OpenVINO™ supports inference on CPU (x86, ARM), GPU (Intel integrated & discrete GPU) and AI accelerators (Intel NPU). Community and Ecosystem : Join an active community contributing to the enhancement of deep learning performance across various domains. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference. Installation Get your preferred distribution of OpenVINO or use this command for quick installation: pip install -U openvino Verify Installation After installation, you can verify OpenVINO is installed correctly by running: import openvino as ov print ( ov . __version__ ) Check system requirements and supported devices for detailed information. Tutorials and Examples OpenVINO Quickstart example will walk you through the basics of deploying your first model. title_es: OpenVINO: toolkit open-source para optimizar modelos de deep learning
bajada: OpenVINO es un toolkit open-source que optimiza e implementa modelos de deep learning en múltiples plataformas desde edge a cloud. Soporta frameworks populares y acelera inference en CPU, GPU y aceleradores especializados.
bajada_en: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit that optimizes and deploys deep learning models across platforms from edge to cloud. Supports popular frameworks and accelerates inference on CPU, GPU, and specialized accelerators.
